Line.zh:
He smiles at you.

He seems to be praising your trapping skills... and this time, he seems to mean it.

name.zh:
The fox blinks at you.

Somehow, you understand. He wants you to call on him... if you ever need his help.

name.zh:
The fox darts away, then stops just before disappearing into the foliage.

He looks back at you and smiles again, taunting you to follow him.
